08037.notes: Colorado tax-lien certificate county. Eagle County Treasurer sells liens on unpaid real estate, mobile homes, and special assessments at an annual online auction via RealAuction (eagle.coloradotaxsale.com) — premium-bid format (premiums not refunded and do not earn interest). Historical pattern mid-November (e.g. Nov 13, 2024; registration/deposit ~1 week prior). Interest rate set at 9 points above federal discount rate (2024 cycle: 15% per year). 3-year redemption before public-auction deed path. Vail / Edwards / Eagle / Gypsum mountain resort market.

auctionPlatform.label: RealAuction — Eagle County Colorado Tax Sale

08037.auctionFrequency: Annually in November (confirm exact date and registration deadline on Treasurer tax lien sale page)
08037.depositRules: Register on eagle.coloradotaxsale.com (W-9 + user agreement). Deposit at least 10% of planned spend via ACH before the published deadline (e.g. 2024: by Nov 6, 2:00 p.m. MT for Nov 13 sale). Successful bidders pay advertised price (tax + interest + advertising + certificate fee) plus any premium bid. RealAuction training webinars available. County employees/relatives barred. Contact Treasurer 970-328-8860.

taxCollector.label: Eagle County Treasurer — Tax Lien Sale

clerkOfCourt.label: Eagle County Clerk and Recorder (land records)

propertyAppraiser.label: Eagle County Assessor — property record search

08037.survivingLiens: Buying a tax lien certificate does not convey the property. After a treasurer's deed issues via the public-auction application path (3 years), most junior private liens are cut off, but federal liens and some governmental assessments can survive. Premiums are not recovered on redemption.
08037.quietTitle: Treasurer's deeds frequently need quiet title (or equivalent) before title companies will insure for resale.

48373.notes: Texas redeemable tax-deed county. Polk County Sheriff/tax foreclosure and trustee sales are held first Tuesday of the month, 10 a.m.–4 p.m., at Dunbar Gym, 1103 Dunbar St, Livingston (location designated effective Aug 10, 2022). Notices posted 21 days prior on courthouse board and polkcountyapps.net/easydocs/foreclosure/. Judicial tax sales after judgment also appear via Linebarger (taxsales.lgbs.com) and occasional Bid4Assets listings. Tax Assessor-Collector / CAD for bidder no-delinquent-tax statements. Livingston / Lake Livingston East Texas market.

auctionPlatform.label: Polk County Sheriff / Clerk — Foreclosure & Tax Sales (Dunbar Gym, Livingston)

48373.auctionFrequency: First Tuesday of the month (or first Wednesday if Jan 1 / July 4) when parcels are posted — verify current notices
48373.depositRules: No typical advance online deposit for in-person TX tax sales. Highest bidders generally pay cash, cashier's check, money order, or other accepted forms per notice (Clerk accepts cashier's checks, money orders, checks, credit cards, cash for certain postings — confirm tax-sale payee). Must present Tax Assessor-Collector statement that purchaser owes no delinquent taxes (Tex. Tax Code §34.015). AS IS sheriff's deed without warranty.

clerkOfCourt.label: Polk County Clerk (foreclosure postings; deed records)

48373.survivingLiens: HOA/POA and some municipal liens can survive if not properly joined. Federal tax liens survive. Statutory redemption: 2 years homestead/ag/mineral; 180 days other property from deed recording. Full title search mandatory.
48373.quietTitle: Not legally mandatory, but title companies generally require quiet title before insuring a Texas tax-sale deed for resale/refinance.

47003.notes: Tennessee redeemable tax-deed county. Bedford County delinquent tax suits are filed in Chancery Court; Clerk & Master collects delinquent taxes plus statutory interest, penalty, court costs, and attorney fees, then conducts judicial public auction sales when ordered (Tenn. Code Title 67, Ch. 5). Current-year taxes remain with the County Trustee (tennesseetrustee.com); older delinquents appear in Clerk & Master portal. Confirm next sale date, format (in-person vs any online shift), and deposit with Clerk & Master 931-684-1672. Shelbyville / I-24 corridor market south of Nashville MSA fringe.
47003.auctionFormat: In-person Chancery / Clerk & Master delinquent tax sale (confirm current notice)

auctionPlatform.label: Bedford County Clerk & Master — Chancery Court delinquent tax sales

47003.auctionFrequency: As Chancery orders and inventory allow — typically periodic/annual pattern in TN counties; confirm with Clerk & Master
47003.depositRules: Chancery/clerk & master sale rules — deposit and balance deadlines are set in the sale notice/order. Certified funds typical. Register or appear as directed in the advertisement. 1-year statutory redemption from court confirmation common (courts may have discretion). Call 931-684-1672 / 931-680-0144 before funding.

taxCollector.label: Bedford County Trustee (current taxes); Clerk & Master (delinquent suits)

47003.survivingLiens: Judicial tax sale subject to statutory redemption after confirmation. After confirmation and redemption expire, most junior private liens are cut off; federal liens can survive. Full title search mandatory.
47003.quietTitle: Court confirmation helps, but quiet title is still commonly used when insurers want additional comfort.

51191.notes: Virginia judicial tax-deed county. Washington County real-estate tax sales are Special Commissioner's sales under Circuit Court decrees, administered with Taxing Authority Consulting Services, PC (TACS / taxva.com) and auctioned as simulcast events (in-person + online) via The Counts Realty & Auction Group (countsauction.com). Recent cycles: March 28, 2025 and October 24, 2025 at Board of Supervisors Room, 1 Government Center Place, Abingdon, 1:00 p.m. Also covers Town of Abingdon parcels when noticed. Abingdon / Bristol / I-81 Highlands market.

auctionPlatform.label: Counts Realty & Auction Group / TACS — Washington County tax sales

51191.auctionFrequency: Periodic Special Commissioner auctions when decrees and inventory are ready (often 1–2 times per year historically) — monitor taxva.com and countsauction.com
51191.depositRules: Highest bidder: deposit of 25% or $1,000 (whichever higher), plus 10% buyer's premium (min $150). Bids under $1,000 paid in full at auction. Deposit max $20,000 per parcel. In-person: personal/cashier's check or money order day of sale (no cash). Online: deposit and premium due within 7 days by certified funds/wire to County of Washington via TACS. Balance and recording costs within 15 days of court confirmation. Bidder may not owe Washington County delinquent taxes.

clerkOfCourt.label: Washington County Circuit Court Clerk (sale confirmation; land records)

propertyAppraiser.label: Washington County Commissioner of the Revenue / assessments

51191.survivingLiens: Proper judicial tax sale after confirmation generally cuts off most junior liens; federal tax liens can survive. Special warranty deed subject to easements, covenants, and rights of record. No warranty of access — landlocked risk. Full independent title search required before bidding.
51191.quietTitle: Court confirmation is the primary clearing step; quiet title may still be used if defects appear in the chain or for insurer requirements.
